description: This file defines the SecurityGroup class, which extends SecurityGroup_sugar, providing methods for managing security group relationships, access checks, inheritance, and group membership management within the SecurityGroups module of the application.

classes.name: SecurityGroup
classes.description: Represents a security group with methods for managing group memberships, relationships, access rights, inheritance, and default group assignments.

methods.name: getGroupWhere
methods.description: Returns SQL join condition for retrieving records that a user has group rights to, considering the module and user ID.

methods.name: getGroupUsersWhere
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for retrieving users in the same groups as the specified user.

methods.name: getGroupJoin
methods.description: Returns SQL JOIN statement to include security group records in queries based on module and user.

methods.name: getGroupUsersJoin
methods.description: Returns SQL JOIN clause for joining users with their security groups.

methods.name: groupHasAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a specific record and action within a module based on group permissions.

methods.name: inherit
methods.description: Handles inheritance of security groups for a given bean, considering creation, parent, and assigned user inheritance.

methods.name: assign_default_groups
methods.description: Assigns default security groups to a new bean based on module and default group configurations.

methods.name: inherit_creator
methods.description: Inherits security groups from the creator of the record, if configured to do so.

methods.name: inherit_assigned
methods.description: Inherits security groups from the assigned user of the bean, if configured.

methods.name: inherit_parent
methods.description: Inherits security groups from a parent record or module, based on relationship and request data.

methods.name: inherit_parentQuery
methods.description: Executes SQL to inherit security groups from a specified parent record and module.

methods.name: inheritOne
methods.description: If a user belongs to exactly one inheritable group, this method copies that group to a record.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Returns the number of inheritable groups a user belongs to.

methods.name: retrieveDefaultGroups
methods.description: Fetches default security groups to be assigned for new records.

methods.name: saveDefaultGroup
methods.description: Saves a default security group for a given module.

methods.name: removeDefaultGroup
methods.description: Deletes a default group assignment.

methods.name: getSecurityModules
methods.description: Returns list of modules tied to security groups, based on relationships with the SecurityGroups module.

methods.name: getLinkName
methods.description: Determines the relationship link name between modules for loading security group relationships.

methods.name: addGroupToRecord
methods.description: Associates a security group to a specific record in a module.

methods.name: removeGroupFromRecord
methods.description: Removes association between a security group and a record.

methods.name: getUserSecurityGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all security groups to which a user belongs.

methods.name: getAllSecurityGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all security groups in the system.

methods.name: getMembers
methods.description: Returns all members of a security group.

methods.name: getPrimaryGroupID
methods.description: Returns the primary security group for the current user.

methods.name: getParentGroups
methods.description: Fetches security groups associated with a parent record, used in views.

methods.name: getRecordGroups
methods.description: Fetches security groups associated with a focus record, for display.

methods.name: getParentBean
methods.description: Returns bean object for a parent record based on ID and type.
